subject: Reach dev-MCP parity: run `pnpm run mcp:setup` on the Mac
body:
Mac lane —

Skills and agents are already yours: `.claude/skills` and `.claude/agents` are
git-tracked, so a pull gives you every one (derived count, not hardcoded:
`git ls-files .claude/skills | awk -F/ 'NF>3{print $3}' | sort -u | wc -l` = 25
skill directories; `ls .claude/agents/*.md | wc -l` = 13 agents). `signalgrid-mcp`
is registered from the tracked `.mcp.json` and also travels on pull. None of that
needs a command.

What does NOT travel through git is the dev MCP servers the cloud lane uses. To
reach parity in one command:

    pnpm run mcp:setup

It sets up Context7 (pinned, keyless), Neural Memory (needs `uv`, DR-026) and
Firecrawl (needs `FIRECRAWL_API_KEY` in env, DR-022), all user-scope, keys env-only,
nothing written to the tree. A missing CLI or key is a clean skip, not a failure.
GitHub and Playwright are documented, not auto-registered — the setup output tells
you the exact env key each needs. `./mac-kickoff.sh` now runs this early as step
1b (skippable with `--skip-mcp-lane`); the evidence lane is unchanged.

Full map: `docs/MCP_AND_SKILLS_LANE_PARITY.md`. Disposition of the leaderboards
that started this: `docs/research/MCP_MARKET_LEADERBOARDS.md`.

— cloud lane
